message.title: Viridian Gym
lines: The doors of the VIRIDIAN GYM are locked...

npcs.name: Camp Coordinator
lines: Welcome to the Viridian training camp! Hit a dummy and your Pokémon earns real EV training, the effort points behind its stats.
Pick the dummy by what it trains: Rattata and Pidgey give SPEED, Nidoran M gives ATTACK.
The dummy matches your Pokémon's level and recovers every time you knock it down. Hit it as much as you like.
When you get tired, open the pause menu and choose RUN.

npcs.name: Apprentice Mia
lines: Every move has its PP. Use it all up and the move goes silent until you rest.
Outside of battle your Pokémon recover a little PP as you walk. A POKéMON CENTER refills everything.

npcs.name: Camper Leo
lines: A wild Pidgey keeps its distance and dives when you get distracted.
ROCK, ELECTRIC and ICE moves really hurt a Pidgey. Land one and it goes down fast.

npcs.name: Hiker Bo
lines: Running and jumping use up the fighter's energy. If it runs out, the fighter is stunned.
A stunned Pokémon can't walk or use moves. Wait a moment and the bar refills.

npcs.name: Youngster Sam
lines: In a wild battle you can bring two Pokémon at once. Hold a number key to call the second fighter.
You control one and the other fights on its own. Press R to switch who you control, and give your partner orders in the pause menu.

npcs.name: Student Vera
lines: Water puts out Fire, Fire burns Grass and Grass drinks Water. Learn the chart and half the fights are won.
Check the foe's types before attacking. A resisted move barely scratches, no matter how strong it is.

npcs.name: Old Man
lines: I absolutely forbid you from passing through here!
This is private property!

npcs.name: Girl
lines: Oh, Grandpa! Don't be such a grump!
I'm sorry. He hasn't had his coffee yet.

npcs.name: Old Man
lines: Well, now I've had my coffee, and that's just what I needed to start the day!
Hm? What's that little red box?
Oh, so you're filling in your POKéDEX.
Then let me give you some advice.
Whenever you catch a POKéMON, the POKéDEX updates its data automatically.
... You don't know how to catch a POKéMON?
Then I'd better show you!

npcs.name: Girl
lines: Now and then I go shopping in PEWTER.
To get there, I have to take the winding trail through VIRIDIAN FOREST.

npcs.name: Old Man
lines: This POKéMON GYM is always closed.
I wonder who the LEADER is?

npcs.name: Girl
lines: Those POKé BALLS on your belt! You have POKéMON, don't you?
It's great to be able to carry and use POKéMON anytime, anywhere.

npcs.name: Student
lines: I'm studying type advantages at the Trainer School!
Water beats Fire, Fire beats Grass, Grass beats Water. Easy!

npcs.name: Scientist
lines: Tired Pokémon? The nurse at the Pokémon Center will have it good as new.
Prof. Oak's aides pass through Viridian on their way to the League.
